Name: Waaagh!
Description:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
- Re-roll advance rolls.
- Become riled up, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is riled up:
- That unit has 5+ InSv.
- That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
- When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Name: Kunnin’ Infiltrator
Description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if each model in this unit is hidden and unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

Name: Deff from the Shadows
Description: At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is in strategic reserves, this unit can make an ingress move.

Name: Da Boss
Description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

Name: Da Grand Warlord's Ladz
Description: While this unit is within 3" of another friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit, this unit has Lone Operative.

Name: Makari, Hoist Dat Banner!
Description: In your Movement phase, you can select a number of friendly ORKS units equal to or less than the current battle round number. Those units are riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Prophet of da Great Waaagh!
Description:
While a friendly ORKS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s melee attacks have:
+1 to hit rolls.
+1 to wound rolls.

Name: Intimidating Motivation
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz
Description:
- This unit has Deep Strike.
- This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Name: Supreme Kunnin’
Description:
In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can:
- Make a normal move of up to D6".
- Or: If this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

Name: Super Runts
Description:
- This unit is riled up.
- This unit’s Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 A, WS and S.

Name: One Last Kill
Description:
In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:

- On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

Name: Da Bigger Dey Iz…
Description: This unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll wound rolls.

Name: Beast Snagga Following
Description: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), this unit has Lone Operative.

Name: Full Throttle
Description:
In your Command phase, select one Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability (see above). This unit has that ability until the start of your next Command phase.

- Turbo Engine: When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

- Shokk Attack Engine: In your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

- Pulse Jet: In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to move, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a pulse jet move.

Name: Waaagh! Banner
Description: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

Name: Keep Huntin’!
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Dodge Dis!
Description: This unit’s attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Name: More Dakka
Description:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
- [Ignores Cover].
- If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

Name: Shokk-boosta
Description:
In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to make an advance move, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can change that advance roll to a 6.
- This unit can move through all types of model.
- When this unit ends that advance move, make a hazard roll for each model in this unit.

Name: Fix Dat Armour Up
Description: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

Name: More Dakka
Description:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
- [Ignores Cover].
- If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

Name: Support Shokka
Description: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN units), this model has Lone Operative.

Name: Sumfin’ to Prove
Description: This unit’s melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Name: Kustom Dakka
Description: This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Name: Clever Know-wotz
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS VEHICLE model (excluding AIRCRAFT/TITANIC models) within 3" of this model:
- That VEHICLE model heals D3 wounds.
- That VEHICLE model’s attacks have +1 to hit rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

Name: Push Dat Bit Back In
Description: In your Command phase, select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit heals 3 wounds.

Name: Hardy Bioniks
Description: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Name: Runnin’ wiv da Herd
Description:
While this model is attached to a MOUNTED unit, this model:
- Does not have INFANTRY.
- Has MOBILE and MOUNTED.
- Has +4" M.

Name: Crude Surgery
Description: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

Name: Catch Dat Red Bit
Description: When this model uses its Crude Surgery ability, you can add D3 to the number of wounds healed.

Name: That’ll Learn Ya
Description:
When this unit becomes battle-shocked, if this unit contains 4+ Gretchin models, you can roll one D3:
- That number of Gretchin models in this unit are destroyed.
- This unit is no longer battle-shocked.

Name: Boss’ Ammo Runt
Description: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Name: Might Is Right
Description:
If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have:
+3 A.
+2 S.

Name: Krushin’ Impetus
Description:
When this unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in this unit engaged with that enemy unit:
- For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Name: Unstable Energies
Description:
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Name: Waaagh! Energy
Description: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section (see above).

Name: Da Jump
Description:
In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Place this unit in strategic reserves.
- This unit has Deep Strike.

Name: Warpath
Description:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit’s melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
- This unit’s melee attacks have [Psychic].

Name: Thundering Stampede
Description: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units within 6" of this unit have +1 to charge rolls.

Name: New rules
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Boss of da Hunt
Description: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), this unit has Lone Operative.

Name: Get Back in da Race!
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly SPEED FREEKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit (and any units embarked within that unit):
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Fuel-mixa Grot
Description: This unit has +1 to advance rolls.

Name: Even More Dakka
Description: If this unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Name: Blitz Dem Gitz!
Description: In your Shooting phase, if this unit’s Blitzkannon weapon targets a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units), that weapon has +6 A.

Name: Mobbed
Description:
When this unit ends a charge move, each enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with this unit makes a battle-shock roll:
- With -1 to that battle-shock roll.
- Or: With -2 to that battle-shock roll if this unit has 13+ models.

Name: Ammo Runts
Description: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Name: Tide of Muscle
Description: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Name: Never Too Busy to Fight
Description: Being engaged does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
